title: rgsaddle
description: rgsaddle finds saddle points on a potential energy surface, the transition states between two minima. It is a Rust library with a C interface and a Python package, and its main searches are: a nudged elastic band (NEB) between two endpoints, with a climbing image; a minimum-mode search from one point, by the dimer method or by Lanczos iteration; an index-1 search on a dense Hessian by restricted-step partitioned rational function optimization (RFO).
